description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * kernel: bonding: alb: fix UAF in rlb_arp_recv during bond up/down (CVE-2026-45970)
  * kernel: gfs2: Fix slab-use-after-free in qd_put (CVE-2026-45861)
  * kernel: gfs2: add some missing log locking (CVE-2026-53049)
  * kernel: Bluetooth: bpa10x: avoid OOB read of revision string in bpa10x_setup() (CVE-2026-64549)
  * kernel: fscrypt: Add missing superblock check in find_or_insert_direct_key() (CVE-2026-68148)
  * kernel: net: bridge: stop fast-leave after deleting a port group (CVE-2026-74480)
  * kernel: net/smc: fix socket use-after-free during link group termination (CVE-2026-74493)
  * kernel: net: smc: fix splice entry lifetime imbalance in smc_rx_splice (CVE-2026-74631)
  * kernel: perf/core: Fix group leader use-after-free after sibling detach (CVE-2026-74637)
  * kernel: smb: client: clear setuid/setgid bit on write with cifsacl/modefromsid/posix extensions (CVE-2026-89638)
  * kernel: arm64: ptrace: Keep 'orig_x0' in-sync with x0 on syscall entry (CVE-2026-90347)
  * kernel: scsi: qla2xxx: Unlink NVMe unsol ctx before freeing on LS reject error (CVE-2026-97528)
  * kernel: kernel: arbitrary code execution via out-of-bounds stack access in scsi_cdl_enable() (CVE-2026-98232)


Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):  

  * netfilter: cve backports for 9.9 (JIRA:RHEL-252129)
  * Backport the printk SMP startup fix [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-290042)
  * [IBM 9.10 FEAT] Switch SIGP to always use external call instead of emergency signal [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-303481)
  * Critical Bug Fixes for customer issues with lpfc [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-286163)
  * The Kernel panic occurred at strlen+0x0 because a race event filter treats the user space pointer as a normal pointer [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-291142)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
